workarounds.name: break-pane window naming
workarounds.summary: tmux 3.7 accepts break-pane -n and ignores it, and crashes the server on a break-pane without -n; breakOut names the window afterwards and is refused when no name is given, and a raw argv without -n, or with -n and without -P, is refused.

workarounds.summary: tmux 3.3 through 3.4 send run-shell output to a pane's copy-mode buffer and exit zero; libtmux refuses it.

workarounds.name: break-pane window naming
workarounds.summary: break-pane gets the new window wrong on exactly tmux 3.7; libtmux refuses it. Nested without -n, it ends the server there; name it with -n or use 3.7a.

workarounds.name: split-window -p
workarounds.summary: split-window -p is broken on tmux 3.4; use -l N%. Nested, tmux reports an error and nothing changes.

workarounds.name: Colon and dot in names
workarounds.summary: tmux 3.7 rejects ':' and '.' in session and window names and creates nothing. Nested, tmux reports an error and nothing changes.

workarounds.name: run-shell output lands in copy mode
workarounds.summary: Foreground run-shell output goes to the pane's copy mode instead of the client, so the call is refused.

workarounds.name: break-pane misnames windows
workarounds.summary: break-pane without a name crashes or misnames the new window; a typed call names it first and repairs the result, a raw one is refused. A break-pane nested in if-shell or run-shell -C is not read, so on exact 3.7 name every break-pane or upgrade to 3.7a.

workarounds.name: split-window percentage size
workarounds.summary: A literal split-window -p fails with a size error; typed percentage requests convert it.

workarounds.name: select-layout kills the server
workarounds.summary: A layout operand tmux cannot parse, or -o, exits the server; typed requests validate the layout and a literal command that could reach the parser is refused.

workarounds.name: Colon and period in names
workarounds.summary: A window or session name holding a colon or period is rejected, so the call is refused before any effect.

capabilities.name: Clipboard query
capabilities.summary: Ask a client's terminal for its clipboard with refresh-client -l. On 3.3a the server exits when a client attached from xterm or tmux-256color receives it, and on 3.4 to 3.6 it exits when the client leaves before its terminal answers.

workarounds.name: run-shell output goes to the pane
workarounds.summary: With no target pane, run-shell sends job output to a pane's view mode instead of the command's own output, so Shell.capturing refuses.

workarounds.name: break-pane misnames the window
workarounds.summary: On 3.7, break-pane gives the new window the default name when -n is given, and a break with no name can end the server, so Pane.breakOut names the window afterwards and a literal or unnamed break is refused.

workarounds.name: split-window -p reads -l
workarounds.summary: On 3.4, split-window -p reads its value from -l, so a literal -p is refused and the typed split sends the percentage with -l.

workarounds.name: Names with a colon or a period
workarounds.summary: On 3.7, new-session, new-window, rename-session and rename-window reject a name that contains a colon or a period, so the library refuses it first.
